index.review1.body: Saw a pair of sunglasses on TikTok selling for ₫120K (~¥50), had been looking for the source. They found me the same factory — wholesale price only ¥3.98. I'm making 30% more profit per order. Totally worth it!
index.review2.body: Was totally lost at first — no 1688 account, couldn't even search for products. Sent them a screenshot, two days later they found the matching factory. Quote was 40% cheaper than my current supplier. Mind blown.
index.review3.body: Most suppliers on Shopee don't offer samples, I've been burned too many times. They actually do individual samples here — I couldn't believe it when I saw it. Finally no more blind-buying thousands worth of stock.
index.review4.body: Was nervous the first time, only picked 10 products as samples — barely ¥50 total. Quality surprised me when they arrived. Now I'm ordering 200 units per SKU to test the market. Cost is half of what I pay locally.
index.review5.body: The inspection step gives me the most peace of mind. They send photos to my WhatsApp when goods arrive at their warehouse — color, size, defects all checked. Only ship internationally after I confirm. Logistics was 2 days slower than expected, but support kept me proactively updated. Great experience overall.
index.review6.body: On my third order, a batch of rattan bags had colors that were noticeably off. I thought I'd have to eat the loss. They proactively offered a free return and sorted it within three days. Honestly, less hassle than buying on 1688 myself.
index.review7.body: My biggest fear the first time was hidden fees — got burned by a sourcing agent before, quoted ¥100, ended up paying ¥180. But here it's really just product cost + shipping + fixed service fee. Every charge is transparent, no surprises at all. Very honest.
index.review8.body: About 12 days from order to delivery. I did absolutely nothing the whole time — they ordered, received, inspected, packed, and shipped internationally. I just sat at home waiting for the package. WhatsApp updates at every step. Saved me countless hours compared to doing it myself.
